entities.name: Libuše Havelková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Libuše Havelková was a Czech actress. She appeared in more than 90 films and television shows between 1957 and 2012. She was married to composer Svatopluk Havelka, with whom she had a son, musician and actor Ondřej Havelka.
